_about: story 5045 (C12 ③): the drafts the app puts into a room composer from the notes a person wrote on lines of the changed-files tab. The app (desktop-electron/src/changes-draft.ts) must produce exactly these; the web must carry them through `?compose=` unchanged and draw them as plain text. The mobile repository keeps this file; the web keeps the same file byte for byte.
